html:
Jococobas is a map name for an Indigenous group of northern Chihuahua in Mexico, in the desert basins southwest of present Ciudad Juárez. Almost nothing is recorded of them under this name.

The region was home to small bands of hunter-gatherers known in Spanish records of the 1600s as the Jocome, Janos, Sumas and others, who later merged with or were absorbed by the Apache. Spanish missions, presidios and wars of the late 1600s, at the time of the Pueblo Revolt, broke up these groups. The Jumanos and Conchos lived to the south and east.
